criteria.description: Documentation catalog loading uses a scoped Nostr query for kind 30023 events tagged bahia-docs.
An empty cached docs event array is ignored so the client queries the relay again.
Empty relay snapshots are not persisted as successful documentation cache entries.
Single-topic document loading resolves documents and internal markdown links from the relay-backed event catalog.
The production docs path does not introduce REST, bundled markdown, local-file, or fake-event fallback behavior.
